title: Greg Isenberg: Startup idea, gamification trend, and the creator-affiliate growth framework
summary: Greg walks through a female solo-travel safety review startup, gamification as an overlooked UI trend and agency niche, and his rebuttal to the "AI wrappers get crushed" thesis. He also shares a three-step framework for growing a SaaS through creators: pick the right creator, offer a 30-50% affiliate cut, and gamify the program.

principles.text: Validate an idea by checking the underlying trend is rising, then capture the search demand around it.
principles.quote: Definitely something I like to see when I'm building uh a startup idea. I want to see that trend growing up going up, right?

principles.text: Build a value ladder: free lead magnet, low-cost community, subscription, then a B2B tier, building trust at each step.
principles.quote: you start with something irresistible and low low barrier and then you build trust at each step.

principles.text: Use a free quiz as the lead magnet. Drive short-form attention to it, capture emails, and nurture to paid.
principles.quote: you convert them into the quiz, you get their email, you can nurture them and sell them later.

principles.text: Pick a narrow, trending niche and become the specialist (e.g. a gamification agency) to reach $10K/month.
principles.quote: if they just focused on gamification, became the gamification person, that's a huge idea. Uh, and I think it starts at 10K a month.

principles.text: AI apps can still win if they own the workflow, the customer, and network effects; platform owners cloning apps hasn't killed app ecosystems before.
principles.quote: provided that they actually own the workflow own the customer uh have network effects are going to be extremely valuable in the future.

principles.text: For SaaS growth, attach the right creators, offer 30-50% affiliate (lifetime early), and gamify the program with big rewards.
principles.quote: I'm not talking about 10% 20%. I'm talking about 30 to 50%. Especially in the initial days, uh give it to them lifetime.
